nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: [Fei falls. The light goes out of their eyes.]

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: [Something changes in Iris's expression. Or rather, something leaves it entirely.]

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: [Iris transforms. Not into anything elegant. A panda—enormous, silent, and going directly for whoever struck Fei.]

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: [Iris begins casting, but not with words or gestures. Something moves through the battlefield like a cold wind.]

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: [Iris is now uncontrollable. They will attack whoever struck Fei until that enemy is eliminated—or until the battle ends.]
